verdict.rationale: Brevo documents Aura AI as an in-product way to ask plain-language questions and get instant answers from your data, which covers AI-generated insights. However, the evidence is limited to brief marketing lines with no depth on proactive suggestions or what kinds of insights it produces. Send-time optimization and contact scoring are related automations, not documented AI insight features, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated suggestions or recommendations for the user drawn from their data, in-depth docs on Aura AI's insight scope and data sources, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
